stem: A firm buys machinery worth Rs 4,00,000 and charges depreciation at 15% per annum under the WDV method. Given that (0.85)^4 = 0.5220, what is the total depreciation charged over the first 4 years?

per_option_rationale.rationale: Book value after 4 years = 400000 x (0.85)^4 = 400000 x 0.5220 = 208800. Total depreciation = cost - book value = 400000 - 208800 = 191200.
Uses SLM: 15% x 400000 = 60000 per year, x 4 years = 240000.
Reports the book value (Rs 2,08,800) as if it were the total depreciation charged.
Calculates SLM depreciation for only 3 years: 15% x 400000 x 3 = 180000, ignoring the 4th year.

explanation: Under WDV, book value after 4 years = 400000 x (0.85)^4 = 400000 x 0.5220 = 208800. Total depreciation over 4 years = original cost - closing book value = 400000 - 208800 = Rs 1,91,200.

explanation_sections.punchline: Total depreciation under WDV equals the fall in book value from original cost: Cost x [1 - (1-r)^n].
explanation_sections.lesson: Do not confuse the book value with total depreciation; total depreciation = cost minus closing book value.
explanation_sections.timing: 55 seconds. Common slip: reporting closing book value (208800) as total depreciation.
